titulo: A Pequena Nuvem que Colecionava Sonhos

elencoIlustra.visual: Small anthropomorphic cloud, feminine essence, pearlescent white skin tone with silver glow. Large, expressive shimmering silver eyes. No hair, body made of soft, fluffy cotton-like vapor. Small and airy build. Wears a translucent, shimmering silver silk scarf wrapped loosely around her neck. Distinguishing feature: glows with a soft moonlight radiance.

7 years old, human female, oval face, light olive skin tone, large dark brown almond-shaped eyes. Long, wavy raven-black hair spreading across her shoulders. Slender child build. Wears oversized pale blue cotton pajamas with white star patterns. Distinguishing feature: a tiny, permanent mischievous smile on the corner of her mouth.

Adult male cat, sleek build, deep midnight blue fur, bright honey-gold intelligent eyes. Long white whiskers, elegant long tail. Wears a small, ornate golden collar with a tiny bell. Distinguishing feature: deep sapphire blue fur that contrasts sharply with glowing amber eyes.

Ancient adult dragon, massive and bulky build, moss-green and antique gold shimmering scales. Heavy lids over sleepy golden eyes. Large nostrils emitting faint silver smoke. No clothing. Distinguishing feature: scales that shift colors between forest green and metallic gold depending on the light.
